main.locality: chart-localities, chart-loc-dist, chart-top-growers, kpi:localities, insight:concentration, insight:top_locality, insight:grapes — part of the grower key (name + locality)
main.manufacturer: chart-top-growers, chart-grower-size, kpi:growers, insight:growers — commercial growers/farms; named only in the top-10 by approved variety lines
main.fruits: chart-families, chart-varieties, chart-tree, chart-localities, chart-notes, kpi:rows, insight:family, insight:grapes, insight:top_locality — species and variety names mixed; a fixed name map groups them into crop families, unknown names stay 'לא מסווג' (share stated)
main.notes: chart-notes, insight:notes — רבעי / גם רבעי / דו שנתי markers
main.validity: chart-validity, chart-inspectors, kpi:expired, insight:expired — fixed dates or 'N חודשים מהבדיקה' (expiry computed from the inspection date)
main.date: chart-inspections, chart-validity, kpi:expired, insight:inspections, insight:expired — inspection date, present on a minority of rows; its max is the reference date for 'expired'
